requirements.quote:
A sender SHOULD send a STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED frame (type=0x15) when it
   wishes to send data but is unable to do so due to stream-level flow
   control.  This frame is analogous to DATA_BLOCKED (Section 19.12).
requirements.condition: A sender wishes to send stream data but cannot because of stream-level flow control.
requirements.required_behavior: The sender should send a STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED frame with type 0x15.
requirements.why_checkable: A runtime test can exhaust stream-level flow-control credit while data remains to be sent and observe whether the sender emits the specified frame type.

requirements.quote:
An endpoint that receives a STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED frame for a send-only
   stream MUST terminate the connection with error STREAM_STATE_ERROR.
requirements.condition: An endpoint receives a STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED frame referring to a send-only stream.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint must not continue the connection after receiving this invalid frame.
requirements.error_behavior: The endpoint must terminate the connection with STREAM_STATE_ERROR.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can deliver the frame for a send-only stream and verify both connection termination and the reported error code.

requirements.condition: A STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED frame is encoded or parsed.
requirements.required_behavior: The Type field must have the fixed value 0x15.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: A frame with another type value must not be treated as a STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED frame.
requirements.why_checkable: The encoded type value or parser dispatch value can be compared directly with 0x15.

requirements.condition: A STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED frame is encoded or parsed.
requirements.required_behavior: The frame must contain Type, Stream ID, and Maximum Stream Data fields in that order.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The fields must not be omitted, reordered, or supplemented within this frame format.
requirements.why_checkable: The serialized frame can be decoded and its field presence and ordering compared with the defined frame grammar.

requirements.quote:
Stream ID:  A variable-length integer indicating the stream that is
      blocked due to flow control.
requirements.condition: A STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED frame carries its Stream ID field.
requirements.required_behavior: The Stream ID must be encoded as a variable-length integer and identify the stream blocked by flow control.
requirements.why_checkable: A parser or encoder test can validate the integer encoding and compare the decoded identifier with the stream whose flow control is blocking transmission.

requirements.quote:
Maximum Stream Data:  A variable-length integer indicating the offset
      of the stream at which the blocking occurred.
requirements.condition: A STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED frame carries its Maximum Stream Data field.
requirements.required_behavior: Maximum Stream Data must be encoded as a variable-length integer and indicate the stream offset at which blocking occurred.
requirements.why_checkable: A parser or encoder test can validate the integer encoding and compare its decoded value with the stream offset where flow-control blocking occurred.
